original.target_description: Full original article not obtained. DOI landing page, Unpaywall, OpenAlex and LMU repository did not supply full paper. Author dissertation includes only an article citation placeholder, not the original paper.

replication.target_description: Replication section 3.1, printed p.946 (PDF p.4): emotion-discrimination accuracy, AN versus healthy controls. Several partial-eta-squared ANOVA terms fit the neutral description, including GROUP and EMOTION-by-GROUP, as well as full-design terms.

reported_success.quote: This is the first study replicating previous results on basic emotion recognition in adolescents with AN

notes: PDF p.4 identifies accuracy results but does not identify a unique factor or interaction. No term selected arbitrarily. Reported success is explicitly the authors’ overall basic-emotion-recognition verdict; it does not identify the missing target test. Replication contains AN and healthy-control groups, not a separate major-depression group. The original dissertation was retained separately as non-article provenance; original terminal miss records acquisition routes.
